CSIRO Mouse Surveillance

Autumn-2023 Seasonal Summary

Published

April 24, 2026

Overview

This report summarizes house mouse monitoring activities conducted during the Autumn-2023 season across Australian grain-growing regions. Mouse abundance was assessed using three complementary survey methods: live-trapping at benchmark sites, and rapid assessments using chew cards and active burrow counts.

Live-trap Surveys: A total of 9,457 trap nights (1 trap night = 1 trap set for 1 night) were conducted across 14 benchmark sites in 5 regions spanning 3 states (survey period: February 2023 to June 2023). These surveys captured 1677 individual house mice, allowing abundance estimates at these monitoring locations.

Rapid Assessment Surveys: Rapid assessments were conducted across 10 regions using two methods. Chew card surveys deployed 1,004 cards across 73 sites, with 8.4% showing evidence of mouse activity (84 cards chewed). Active burrow surveys searched 339 transects across 73 sites (survey period: March 2023 to May 2023), detecting active burrows in 11.8% of transects (total: 116 active burrows).
